skill.name: GIF
skill.description: Find, search, and create GIFs with proper optimization and accessibility.
skill.summary: Requirements **Required for creating GIFs:** - `ffmpeg` — video to GIF conversion **Optional:** - `gifsicle` — post-optimization (reduces size 30-50%) - `GIPHY_API_KEY` — for Giphy search API - `TENOR_API_KEY` — for Teno
